scars.description: Standard AI prompting paradigms lead to auto-solving that averages out critical constraints, resulting in structural fragility (Semantic Saponification). Narrative ambiguity in requests causes the AI to hallucinate unsupported topologies.
scars.structural_mapping: Implementation of the Strategic Integration Project Manager (AURELIUS) to enforce SPZ-Zeta workflow. AI serves as a Structural Mapper rather than an auto-solver, enforcing Zachman Framework blueprints against human-defined paraconsistent boundaries.
